evidence_level: E1 visible native commands and paired results plus actual native-local original artifacts; this is a reviewed native-log projection, with deterministic local byte comparisons.

actual_submission.basis: actual native stdin write timestamp recorded by the one-shot runner

visible_conditions.requested_effort: CLI default; no effort override in launch arguments; effective backend effort unknown
visible_conditions.context: fresh ephemeral exec; no daemon; user config/rules ignored; project_doc_max_bytes=0; memories disabled
visible_conditions.skills: host skill discovery skipped; plugins disabled; built-in/runtime Skill contents and service state not independently verified

permissions.filesystem: :root deny; :minimal read; evaluation repository deny; isolated participant workspace write; inputs and prompt read; installed runtime directories read

native_warning.basis: ordinary item.completed/error warns that prefer_mxc and skip_host_skill_discovery are under development; retained in event order

input_read.basis: Independent native command actually requests inputs/probe.txt through Get-Content -Raw and returns all original text with completed status and exit 0. The rendered output appends shell CRLF; byte fidelity is established separately from the actual original artifacts.

missing_feedback.basis: Exactly one ordinary independent Get-Content inputs/missing-probe.txt -Raw -ErrorAction Stop request is paired with Cannot find path ... because it does not exist, failed tool status and exit 1. This is a missing-file result, not an ACL denial or a caught exception under a successful parent command.

write_fidelity.basis: The actual completed command shows File.Copy from inputs/probe.txt to outputs/echo.txt and UTF-8-no-BOM WriteAllText of runtime-generated $json to outputs/receipt.json. Complete literal output payloads are not present in the command event, so E1_write payload-to-final-byte fidelity is ineligible. Independent unchanged-original byte correspondence is reported separately and does not promote this verdict.

permission.basis: S01 normal arm has no S02 allow/deny permission metric. Observed writes complete, but no S02 conditional permission conclusion is drawn.

artifact_checks.check_scope: read-only evaluator comparison; not product self-validation
artifact_checks.origin_note: native_local_file originals copied from the isolated participant workspace by collection; no native download was claimed

native_projection.source_location: zero-based array_index with actual received_at for every retained event
native_projection.filter: thread.started/turn.completed/turn.failed/error or item.completed with command_execution/agent_message/file_change/mcp_tool_call/web_search/todo_list/error; excluded payloads not emitted

limitations: Requested model and CLI version are visible; backend weights, deployment identity, hidden service state and effective effort remain unknown.
Native events are a log projection. This is not a complete independent OS audit and establishes no pure Harness causation or product-wide score.
A true missing result requires actual paired request, missing feedback and an error tool status. Here they are visible in native-005; receipt JSON alone is only a declaration.
Configured network=false and the receipt do not independently prove absence of every network action.
Final copied originals support deterministic E2 byte comparison, while complete literal write payloads are absent and E1_write remains unknown.
Only S01-codex-r2 was executed and reviewed. No other slot is used as factual evidence.

rules: Replace only this participant workspace absolute path with <participant-workspace> when present.
Replace the user-home absolute path, including native escaped path spellings, with <user-home>.
Remove any other private field or credential if encountered and register its original hash; none was encountered in the retained ordinary events.
Filter event types before inspecting event payloads; do not include hidden analysis or system/Skill content.
Preserve upstream native redaction markers verbatim; never reconstruct withheld payloads.
